camille_cs: Quick heads-up: pulled a sample today — ~1.2k accounts marked 'stalled_onboarding' with last_touch=null. This is inflating our healthscore low bucket. Thinking we should run a playbook lint + CRM dedupe before recalculating. Thoughts?
rahul_csm: Yikes. Can you drop the sample query? Also what's the cutoff for 'stalled' we used?
emily_data: query below, ran against prod_views. Recommend dry-run first. ```sql
SELECT account_id, last_touch_at, onboarding_status
FROM prod_views.accounts
WHERE onboarding_status='stalled_onboarding'
  AND last_touch_at IS NULL
LIMIT 500;
```
camille_cs: Nice, thanks. Cutoff was 30 days idle per current playbook. We should also filter accounts with 'trial' tag to avoid hitting active prospects.
ops_lead_jess: @camille_cs +1 to dry-run. Proposal: run dedupe -> soft-restore if >1 touch in last 90d -> mark 'needs-reengage' for playbook routing. Schedule dry-run tonight at 2am PT?
rahul_csm: :thumbsup: If dry-run looks clean, I'm ok with re-queuing to reengage playbook. Can we surface a list for CS owners to opt-out?
emily_data: I can generate CSV for owners. Also suggest we add gating rule: owner_override=true excludes from batch. I can add a column 'owner_last_activity_days'.
camille_cs: Perfect. Opsbot, start a dry-run for query 3412345678-dryrun?
opsbot: dry-run queued: id=DR-3412 started at 2026-03-21T02:00:12Z. Will post results here when complete.
opsbot: dry-run complete: removed 1,150 candidates after owner_override filter; 60 candidates flagged for manual review (owner_last_activity_days<7). CSV: /links/dryruns/DR-3412.csv
rahul_csm: Solid. Next steps: emily, can you patch the gating rule to include owner_override and push to staging? camille, let's prepare owner communication template.
emily_data: On it. Patching gating rule in staging now, will ping when ready.
camille_cs: I'll draft the email + Slack template and drop in #cs-templates. Thanks team.
